TalentSage: AI hiring intelligence for high-volume teams
A hybrid B2B SaaS model combining a hiring workflow subscription with usage-based AI evaluation, assessment and interview capacity.

Initial beachhead: BPO/contact-center and technology-services firms with recurring roles and large candidate pools.
Buyers: Head of TA, HR Operations leader, HR manager or business owner.
Users: recruiters, HR managers and hiring managers.
Pakistan entry: SMEs and enterprise teams needing affordable recruitment automation.
Expansion: agencies, universities, GCC employers and ATS-integrated global teams.

div.div: Product, AI and engineering team; cloud hosting, storage and AI model usage; speech, video interview and communication infrastructure. Sales, marketing, events and customer success; ATS integration, security, legal and compliance; administration and company operations.

Monthly/annual subscriptions: Basic $39, Pro $119 and Business $349 per tenant/month as current hypotheses. AI evaluation, deep-dive, assessment and Riya interview credits; enterprise contracts, integration, implementation, security and premium support.

div.span: Public application version - no customer-sensitive data or internal vendor cost detail.

div.div: Assumptions and Validation Plan
What TalentSage will prove during NICAT incubation
The canvas separates current evidence from commercial assumptions. The 12-month goal is to convert a working platform and early demand into paid, repeatable customer outcomes.
Current stage
Working product | early design-partner validation
Pre-revenue | Pakistan commercialization focus
Founder-led product demonstrations
External trial organizations provisioned
Organizations completed onboarding
Expressed intent to move to a paid plan
MRR today - payment conversion is next
Evidence date: 18 July 2026 - refresh before external updates.

div.p: BPO/contact-center and technology-services teams will show the strongest pain, usage and willingness to pay.
A unified, explainable candidate evidence record will matter more than another standalone score or interview bot.
TalentSage can sell as a complete workflow and as an evidence layer alongside an existing ATS.
Subscription plus usage credits will balance affordability, expansion revenue and variable AI costs.
Demo -> trial -> activation -> value review -> paid design partner can become a repeatable B2B process.
Pakistan validation can create references for GCC and global ATS-integrated sales.

div.div: Milestones focus on proof, not feature volume.

tr.td: Will target employers pay for proof-of-value?
Recruit 5-8 qualified organizations; baseline workflow; run a 30-60 day deployment.
3-5 paid design partners, signed terms and buyer references.
Corporate introductions, mentor review and pilot structuring.
Which segment and route produce the strongest activation?
Compare BPO, software services and other internal TA teams.
One defined ICP, conversion benchmarks and a named-account playbook.
Industry network and commercial mentoring.
Does TalentSage improve capacity, speed or evidence consistency?
Capture baseline, usage, after-period results and approved methodology.
2 quantified case studies and 2 referenceable customers.
Measurement design and domain advisors.
Which plan, term and usage model buyers accept?
Test monthly vs annual, enterprise packaging and usage credits.
Validated paid price points and actual usage profile.
Finance mentors and investor readiness.
Do integration and data controls remove procurement objections?
Prioritize one ATS connector; implement retention, deletion and logs.
First connector live and enterprise pilot acceptance.
Technical, security and legal advisors.
Can the motion become repeatable beyond founders?
Document onboarding, customer success, pipeline stages and monthly KPIs.
8-12 paying organizations target and a seed-ready evidence pack.
Demo Day, investor preparation and growth network.

div.div: Public pricing positionFree, Basic $39, Pro $119 and Business $349 are current hypotheses. Enterprise pricing is custom and must be validated.
Economics guardrailThe model targets about 50% feature-level contribution. This is not yet validated company gross margin.
Evidence disciplineTrials are not customers, verbal interest is not revenue, and performance claims require controlled measurement.

div.span: Internal evidence source: TalentSage product, traction and pricing registers.
